content: In the name Of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful Step by step explanation of the daily 5 Contact Prayers. What to do. What to say. United Submitters International 739 E 6th street, Tucson, AZ 85719 (602) 791 - 3989 - Page 1 - Abraham: Original Source of the Contact Prayers The Quran teaches us in many suras that Submission (in Arabic “Islam”) is the religion of Abraham (please consult 2:135, 3:95, 4:125, 6:161 and 22:78). Muhammad was a follower of Abraham, as we learn from 16:123. All religious practices in Submission (Islam) were given to us through Abraham; they include: (1) the five daily Contact Prayers (Salat), (2) the obligatory charity (Zakat), (3) the fasting during Ramadan, and (4) the Hajj Pilgrimage to Mecca. Specifically, we learn from the Quran (21:73) that the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat) were given to Abraham. Numerous verses throughout the Quran inform us that the Contact Prayers were in existence, intact, and practiced before the advent of Muhammad (see for example 8:35 & 9:54). All positions of the Contact Prayers are found in the Quran, including the standing position (3:39, 39:9), and the bowing and prostrating positions (Rukoo’ and Sujood) (2:43, 3:43, 9:112, 22:26 & 77). The Five Times Are Specified in the Quran (1) The Dawn Prayer is mentioned by name in 24:58. Before sunrise . (2) The Noon Prayer is specified in 17:78. When the sun declines. (3) The Afternoon Prayer is in 2:238. Midway between noon and sunset. (4) The Sunset Prayer is mentioned in 11:114. Immediately after sunset. (5) The Night Prayer is in 11:114, and is mentioned by name in 24:58. The Call to Prayer (Azaan) Azaan is not a part of the Contact Prayers, nor is it required. But it has become a tradition in the Muslim communities to summon the people to prayer through a loud announcement. The original Azaan used to conform with the Quran’s teachings, and became corrupted with time. Originally, the call to prayer consisted of: (1) Allahu Akbar (God is Great), 4 times. (2) Laa Elaaha Ellah Allah (There is no other god beside God), once. Many years later, some people added Muhammad’s name to the Azaan. This violates God’s co m mandments in 2:136, 2:285, 3:84, 4:150 and 72:18. Later, other groups of Muslims added the names of Ali and his family. Today, the Azaan is severely corrupted throughout the Muslim world, and constitutes idol worship, not Submission to God ALONE. - Page 2 - The Correct Azaan If you pray by yourself, an Azaan is not needed. The Azaan is usually observed when a group of people are ready to observe the prayer. One person stands up and utters the Azaan words, or chants them as follows: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar (God is Great, God is Great). Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar. La Elaaha Ella Allah (There is no other god beside God). Preparation for the Contact Prayer (The Ablution) O you who believe, in preparation for the Contact Prayer, you shall (1) wash your faces, (2) wash your arms to the elbows, (3) wipe your heads with wet hands, and (4) wash your feet to the ankles. [5:6] Like all other aspects of Submission, the Muslims have corrupted the ablution by adding unauthorized steps. Ironically, the innovations became vested with such authority that anyone who questions them finds himself accused of innovation!! It is therefore crucial to uphold God’s commands by strictly observing the ablution decreed in the Quran. Any additional steps represent another god besides God. The Major Ablution Following any sexual activity that results in a climax (orgasm/ejaculation), one must bathe or take a shower (4:43). The Dry Ablution (Ta y ammum) If water is not available, one must touch clean dry soil, then wipe his hands and face. This suffices as a substitute for ablution (4:43; 5:6). What Nullifies Ablution Digestive excretions through the intestines, including gas, solids, or urine nullify ablution. Sleeping also nullifies ablution, since one becomes unaware. Thus, one may observe a number of Contact Prayers with one ablution, provided he or she does not go to the bathroom, pass gas, or fall asleep. - Page 3 - HOW TO PERFORM THE CONTACT PRAYERS 1. Face the direction of Mecca (Qiblah): This is an organizational point decreed by God in 2:125. God wills that all Submitters must face the same direction when they observe the Contact Prayers. In the U.S., the direction is slightly South of East. 2. The Intention: In your own language, secretly or audibly, state your intention that you are about to observe the Contact Prayer. Remember to state the time (Dawn, Noon, Afternoon, Sunset, or Night). 3. Raise your hands to the sides of your face: Your thumbs touch your ears, and the palms of your hands face forward. 4. Say, “Allahu Akbar”: As you raise your hands to the sides of your face, then move them down to your sides in a continuous motion, you say, “Allahu Akbar” (God is Great). This opens up the prayer. You are in contact with your Creator. 5. The Standing Position: You are now standing with your arms resting naturally at your sides. Some people place the left hand on the stomach, and the right hand on top of the left hand. Either position is correct you may place your hands on your stomach while standing, or you may let your arms hand down by your sides. 6. Recite “The Key” (Sura 1) in Arabic: We learn from 2:37 that God gives us the words by which we establish contact with Him. We must utter the specific sounds dictated in “The Key.” A translation of “The Key” would be human - made. The Arabic sounds of “The Key” represent a numerical How to Do t he Prayers 41 combination that opens the treasure. Like a telephone number, unless the specific numbers are dialed, contact cannot be established. This is all the Arabic you need. Everything else can be said in your own language. - Page 4 - Reciting “The Key” in Arabic unifies all Submitters of the world, regardless of their languages. [ The Key: ] 1. BISMIL LAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM. (In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.) 2. AL HAMDU LILLAAHI RABBIL ‘AALAMEEN. (Praise be to God, Lord of the universe.) 3. AR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM. (Most Gracious, Most Merciful.) 4. MAALIKI YAWMID DEEN. (Master of the Day of Judgment.) 5. EYYAAKA NA’BUDU, WA EYYAAKA NASTA’EEN. (Only You we worship; only You we ask for help.) 6. EHDENAS SIRAATAL MUSTAQEEM. (Guide us in the straight path.) 7. SIRAATAL LAZINA AN’AMTA ‘ALAYHIM (The path of those whom You blessed) GHAYRIL MAGHDOOBI ‘ALAYHIM WALADDAALLEEN (Not of those who incur wrath, nor the strayers). Since “The Key” is recited 17 times a day, it will become easy for you to recite and understand in a few weeks; it will become like your mother tongue. 7. The bowing position (Rukoo’): After reciting “The Key” while standing, you bow down into the position of Rukoo’. As shown in the figure, you bow down from the waist, keep the knees straight, and place your hands on your knees. Your eyes look at a point about 2 feet in front of you. As you move from the standing position to the bowing position you say, “Allahu Akbar.” While bowing you say, “Subhaana Rabbiyal ‘Azeem” or “God be glorified.” 8. Stand up: As you stand up from the bowing position to the standing position you say, “Sami ‘Allahu Liman Hamidah,” or “God responds to those who praise Him.” - Page 5 - You remain in the standing position only a second, then you fall prostrate. As you go from the standing position to the prostration position you say, “Allahu Akbar.” 9. The Prostration Position (Sujood): From the standing position you go down on your knees, then place your forehead on the floor about 1 - 2 feet in front of your knees (see figure). During prostration you say, “Subhaana Rabbiyal A’laa” or “God be glorified.” 10. The Sitting Position: As you sit up from the prostration position, you say, “Allahu Akbar.” You remain in the sitting position only a second, then you go down for the second prostration. As you go down for the second prostration you say, “Allahu Akbar.” During the second prostration you say, “Subhanna Rabbiyal A’laa.” Once you complete the second prostration, you have completed one full unit (Rak’ah). 11. Stand up for the second unit: As you stand up you say, “Allahu Akbar.” The Dawn Prayer This Contact Prayer consists of 2 units. Thus, when you get up from the second prostration, you say, “Allahu Akbar,” and you assume the sitting position. While in the sitting position you pronounce the First Pillar of Submission, the Shahaadah: Ash - Hadu Allaa Elaaha Ellaa Allah. (I bear witness that there is no other god beside God.) Wahdahu Laa Shareeka Lah. (He ALONE is God; He has no partner.) Look to the right and say, “Assalaamu Alaikum,” then to the left and say the same. This completes the Dawn Prayer. - Page 6 - The Noon Prayer This prayer consists of 4 units. Thus, you do the first two units exactly as explained for the Dawn Prayer up to the sitting position [step 10]. You pronounce the First Pillar (known as “Shahaadah”) then you stand up for the third unit. You do not utter the Salaams (Assalamu Alaikum). As you stand up for the third unit you say, “Allahu Akbar.” The third and fourth units are identical to the first two units. When you get up from the second prostration of the fourth unit, you say “Allahu Akbar” and you assume the sitting position. In the sitting position you pronounce the Shahaadah, and you say the Salaams on both sides. This concludes the Noon Prayer. The Afternoon Prayer This prayer is identical to the Noon Prayer. Only the “Intention” of course is different. The Sunset Prayer This prayer consists of three units. Thus, when you complete the second prostration of the third unit you do not stand up; you assume the sitting position, recite the Shahaadah, then you utter the Salaams on both sides. This concludes the Sunset Prayer. The Night Prayer This prayer is identical with the other 4 - unit prayers, the Noon and the Afternoon Prayers. The Contact Prayers and the Quran’s Mathematical Code As noted above, the Dawn, Noon, Afternoon, Sunset and Night Prayers consist of 2, 4, 4, 3, & 4 units, respectively. When we put these 5 numbers next to each other we get 24434, and this number is a multiple of 19 (24434 = 19 x 1286). The common denominator of the Quran’s code is 19. This phenomenon confirms that the number of units for each Contact Prayer has been reserved intact, and the sequence 2, 4, 4, 3 and 4 is also confirmed. Your Tone of Voice During the Contact Prayers Your shall not be too loud during your Contact Prayers, nor shall you say them secretly; you shall maintain an intermediate tone [17:110]. During a group prayer, only the Imam is audible; everyone else listens. - Page 7 - The Group Prayer Two or more people may observe the Contact Prayers together. One person leads the group prayer, uttering “The Key” in a loud enough voice to be heard by everyone in the group. Other utterances must be silent. Anyone may join the group late, in the middle of the prayer . He or she must make the same moves as the group, then, at the end of the prayer, he or she must stand up and make up whatever portion was missed. The Friday Prayer The Friday Congregational Prayer (Salat Al - Jum’ah) is so important, a whole sura is entitled “Friday” and a commandment is decreed in verse nine to observe this prayer. Every Submitter - man, woman, and child - is commanded by God to observe the Friday Congregational Prayer. The Friday Prayer replaces the Noon Prayer every Friday. Instead of 4 units, the Friday Prayer consists of listening to two sermons delivered by the Imam, and two units of prayer. Each sermon must begin with “Al - Hamdu Lillah” (Praise be to God), “Laa Elaaha Ella Allah” (No other god beside God). Each sermon should last 10 - 15 minutes and must be delivered in the language of the congregation. At the end of the first sermon, the congre gation is asked to repent, “Tooboo Ela Allah.” The Imam then sits down for about a minute and makes his repentance together with the congregation, then stands up for the second sermon. The second sermon ends by asking one of the people to say the Azaan. Th e Imam then leads the 2 - unit prayer. At the end of every prayer The worshipers may shake hands, hug each other, and/or exchange greetings after completing the prayer. The custom is to say to each other, “Congratulations.” This is because the Contact Prayers are a gift from God, that helps us nourish and develop our sou ls. One should be congratulated upon completing such a blessed accomplishment. For More Information This booklet should be used in conjunction with our audio or video tape in order to practice the correct pronunciation of the Arabic words. The audio/video tape provides the sounds and visual effects that will help you learn the correct pronunciations. Just how serious is expressed in verse 40 of Sura 7: "Surely, those who do not believe our revelations, and are too arrogant to heed them, the gates of the sky never open for them, nor will they ever enter Paradise until the camel passes through the needle's eye. - 19 - QURAN: YOU SHALL NOT IDOLIZE MUHAMMAD There are only two verses in Quran that describe the pro- phet Muhammad as "no more than a human being like you. ,! You will witness physical, touchable, examinable, and perpetual miracles, which prove that the Qur ’ an is indeed word of God, and that it comes to use perfectly p reserved. As most of you know, all the messengers of God were supported by miracles, supernatural phenomena which proved that they were indeed sent by the Almighty God to deliver his message. For example. when Moses went to Pharaoh, he was supported by m iracles such as the turning of his staff into a serpent. The Prophet Jesus was supported by miracles such as the healing of the leprous and the hopelessly blind, reviving the dead, and creating birds from clay. Since the Prophet Muhammad was the last mes senger from God, it is only logical that his miracle, which is consequently the last miracle, should be eternal, and perpetual, in order to be witnessed by all the generations of human beings from the time of Muhammad's mission to the end of the world. Thi s presentation is a manifestation of this logical conclusion; right here and now, you will witness the perpetual miracle of Muhammad. As you know, the miracles of all previous

2 messengers were limited by time and place. None of us witnessed Moses when he tu rned his staff into a serpent, none of us saw Jesus revive the dead. Only the people who were present in a specific place. at a specific time, did witness those miracles. But the miracle of Muhammad was witnessed by all the past generations, it is being wi tnessed by our generation, it will be witnessed by you right here and now, and it will be witnessed by all future generations. What is the miracle of Muhammad? The divine message delivered by Muhammad, the Qur'an states in sura 29, verses 49, 50 that Muh ammad's miracle is the Qur'an itself. Indeed, we find that the Qur'an, the last divine miracle manifested through the last messenger of God, we find it perpetual. Every generation during the last 1400 years did witness miraculous manifestations in the Qur' an. As the mysteries of the universe we unveiled by advancing science and technology, the people discovered that the new discoveries were already revealed in the Qur'an. For example, when the rotation movement of the planet earth was discovered, the studen ts of Qur'an noted that this was already stated in sura 27, verse 88, "When you look at the mountains, you may think they are standing still. But they are moving, similar to the movements of the clouds. Such is the skillful creation of God, who perfected e verything." When it was discovered that the sun is a "Source" of light, and the moon a mere reflection, we learned that these discoveries were as old as the Qur'an. In sura 10, verse 5; sura 25. verse 61; and sura 71, verse 16, we find that the sun is cons istently called a lamp "SIRAJ" and the moon described as a lighted object. It will take me hours to point out all the miraculous features manifested in the Qur'an over the past 1400 years. But this presentation deals with the Qur'anic miracles being man ifested to our generation. Together we will witness Muhammad's perpetual miracle, you will see it, touch it, and witness it just as physically

3 as Pharaoh, the magicians, and the Israelites witnessed the miracles of Moses, and just as physically as the disc iples of Jesus saw him revive the dead. You will undeniably appreciate the perpetuity of Muhammad ’ s miracle. بد الله الرحمن الرحيم The key to Muhammad's perpetual, eternal, miracle is found in the very first verse of Qur'an which says, "IN THE NAME. OF G OD, THE COMPASSIONATE, THE MERCIFUL" ( ِ ه اللّٰ ِ م ْ س ِ ب ِ م ي ۪ ح َّ ر ل ا ِ ن ٰ م ْ ح َّ ر ل ا ) When we count the letters that make up this verse, we find them 19. As you see, this is a physical fact. No one can argue with you about it. And it was discovered that every word in this verse is mentioned in the whole Qur'an a number of times which is always multiples of 19. Let me repeat this observation; the first verse in the Qur'an, consists of 19 letters, and every word in this first verse is mentioned in the Qur'an a number of times which is consistently multiples of 19. The first word اسم "NAME" is found in the whole Qur'an exactly 19 times; the second word "ALLAH" is ِ ه اللّٰ mentioned in the Qur'an 2,698 times and this number is a multiple 19, it equals 19 x 142; the third word of the verse," ِ ن ٰ م ْ ح َّ ر ل ا "AL - RAHMAN" is found repeated in the Qur'an 57 times, 3 multiples of 19, and finally, the fourth word in the first Qur'anic verse ِ م ي ۪ ح َّ ر ل ا "AL - RAHIM" is mentioned in the whole Qur'an 114 times, 6 multiples of 19. At this early stage, I am sure that Satan will interfere, and will whisper in your heart saying. "How do you know he is stating correct numbers? How do you know he is not making up these numbers? To eliminate this Satanic influence once and for all from the beginning , let me remind you that all these numbers have been documented many times in the past, before any of us was born. The words of Qur'an have been count ed by many scholars in the past, and their findings are documented in many great classic books. One such reference that I carry with me everywhere is the book entitled المعجم المفهرين الْلفاظ القرآن الحكيم "INDEX TO THE WORDS OF QUR ’ AN" by Muhammad Faud

4 Ab dul - Baqi, and published by the People's Press دار الشعب of Cairo, Egypt. All the numbers I mentioned here, though they were discovered independently through the use of electronic computers, are also found in this book, and many other books as well. As yo u note, we are dealing with strict physical facts; and they are facts that do not require knowledge of the Arabic language to be appreciated. This proves to us that the Qur'an was not revealed only for the Arabs, but for all the people on earth. For exampl e, you do not need to know Arabic to count the letters in the first Qur'anic verse and confirm that they arc 19. And this is of course a physical fact; no guesswork, interpretation, or conjecture is involved. The number 19 itself is a special number; it co ntains the beginning and the end, the numeral 1 which is the beginning of the mathematical system and the numeral 9 which is the end. Also, we note that the number 19 is not divisible by any other number. For example, while the number 20 is divisible by 2, 4,5, and 10; and the number 18 is divisible by 2, 3, 6, and 9, the number 19 is not divisible. What do these observations mean? These are physical facts that no one can argue about. The first factual observation is that the first verse of the Qur'an con sists of 19 letters. The second factual observation is that every word in this verse is mentioned in the Qur'an in multiples of 19, the word اسم NAME is mentioned throughout the Qur'an 19 times, the word ALLAH is mentioned 2,698, 19 x 142, the word AL - RAHM AN is mentioned 57 times, 19 x 3; and the word AL - RAHIM is mentioned 114 times. WHAT DO THESE FACTUAL OBSERVATIONS MEAN? There are only 3 possible explanations, or conclusions, to be derived from these facts. THE FIRST EXPLANATION is that this phenomenon h appened by sheer accident; by coincidence. However, this explanation can easily be rejected. since coincidence may happen once or twice but not 3 times: certainly

5 not 4 times as we see here. in other words, if you pick up any man - made book and if the lette rs in the first sentence , the possibility that the one word in this sentence is repeated in the whole book in a manner related to the number of letters in the sentence, this possibility is there; may be. But the possibility that 2 words in this sentence ar c repeated in whole book relative to the number of letters which make up the sentence, this possibility is very slim. And the chance that 3 words are repeated in this manner by sheer coincidence is considered impossible. Here we. find all 4 words of the fi rst Qur'anic verse mentioned in the whole Qur'an multiples of 19, the number of letters which make up the verse. And this could never happen by coincidence. THE SECOND POSSIBLE EXPLANATION is that the Prophet Muhammad himself designed and wrote the Qur' an in this numerical system. This of course what all the non - Muslims claim. For if they thought or believed that the Qur'an is God's message to them, they would have become Muslims. In effect what this second conclusion says is that an illiterate man who l ived in the seventh century, and possessed no sophisticated mathematical knowledge, said to himself. "I am going to write a book, a large book, where the first sentence consists of 19 letters, and every word in this sentence shall be repeated in the whole book in multiples of 19. Then he proceeded to write the book following this design, over a period of 23 years. You can see how absurd this conclusion is. Even now, some of those opponents may still insist that Muhammad wrote the Qur'an. To these stubborn d isbelievers, we can ask the question. "If Muhammad designed and wrote the Qur'an in this unique manner, why then did n 't he reap the fruits of his efforts? If he were an imposter, why didn't he boast and pride himself on this remarkable achievement? We do n ot know of any book in history with a numerical system like this. Why didn ’ t the Prophet show off among his companions? All these findings were never known prior to June 1975.

6 THE ONLY POSSIBLE EXPLANATION LEFT is that a SUPER BEING did write the Qur'an, with its complicated mathematical design. The inescapable conclusion is that the Qur'an was authored by the Omnipotent, Omniscient, and Omnipresent Almighty God. For, as you will witness before the end of these 60 minutes what we discussed so far is only the tin of the iceberg, only a minute portion of the total mathematical system of the Qur'an. This is the first verse of sura 10, and it says, "A.L.R. This is a scripture whose verses have been perfectly designed, then elucidated. It comes from the most Wise, most Cognizant". Not only do these facts prove that the Qur'an is the word of God, but also do they prove that the Qur'an was never distorted, nor altered in any way, nor was any part of it lost, deleted, or added. You see, when you recite, "Qul Huwallahu Ahad" د َ ح َ ا ُ ه اللّٰ َ و ُ ه ْ ل ُ ق the word ALLAH here is counted and perfectly placed in this specific position. It is one of the 2,698 ALLAH words found in the Qur'an. And when you continue by saying. "Allahus Samad" ُ ه َ اللّٰ ُ د َ م َّ ص ل ا this word ALLAH also is perfectly designed and counted. Thus, the 2 important conclusions to be remembered here are (1) THE QUR'AN IS GOD'S MESSAGE TO ALL HUMANITY, and (2) THE QUR'AN HAS BEEN PROTECTED AND PRESERVED; it is God's unaltered, final, and ete rnal message. This is verse 9 sura 15, stating, "Surely, we did reveal this scripture, and surely we will preserve it". Does the number 19 itself have any explicit mention or significance in the Qur'an? YES INDEED. We find the number 19 in verse 30 o f sura 74, sura AL - MUDDATHIR. And we find it mentioned as the answer to those who claim that the Qur'an is man - made. Thus, when we read verses 11 through 37 of this sura, we find them stating that anyone who reaches the conclusion or the belief that the Qu r'an is man - made, not the word of God, this

7 person will have the number 19 imposed on him; he will have the number 19 to reckon with. The old interpretation of this verse (verse 30 of sura 74) is that 19 are the angels guarding Hell. But in view of these n ew findings, and in the new light being shed on the verse immediately following this verse, we find that the number 19 was mentioned in verse 30 for 5 distinct reasons; (1) to cause a great disturbance ( فتنة ) to the disbelievers (and certainly these findin gs about the number 19 will disbelievers), (2) to assure the good Christians and the good Jews who see nothing wrong with the Qur'an, but they are not quite sure whether or not it is a scripture from God, to assure them that it is God's message to them; an d that it constitutes the finalization and consummation of their own scriptures, (3) to augment and strengthen the faith of the believers, who already believe that the Qur'an is the word of God, (4) to eliminate any doubts that may linger in the hearts of the believers and/or the good Christians and finally, (5) to expose the hypocrites and the disbelievers, and to stamp them once and for all as unfortunate fanatics whom God wills to send astray. In addition to these 5 reasons stated in verse 31, as to wh y the number 19 was selected in verse 30, we find that verse 31 also states that only God knows the real number of His soldiers. Therefore, the number 19 is not the number of angels, guardians of Hell, and we have to accept a new interpretation of the numb er 19 of verse 30, in view of these new Qur'anic findings. ُ ه ُ ق ِ ه ْ ر ُ ا َ س ۜ ا د ي ۪ ن َ ع ا َ ن ِ ت ا َ ي ٰ ِ لْ َ ن ا َ ك ُ ه َّ ن ِ ا ۜ َّ لَّ َ ك َۗ َ د ي ۪ ز َ ا ْ ن َ ا ُ ع َ م ْ ط َ ي َّ م ُ ث ًۙ ا د ي ۪ ه ْ م َ ت ُ ه َ ل ُ ت ْ د َّ ه َ م َ و َّ د َ ق َ ف ْ ي َ ك َ ل ِ ت ُ ق َ ف ًۙ َ ر َّ د َ ق َ و َ ر َّ ك ـ َ ف ُ ه َّ ن ِ ا ۜ ا د و ُ ع َ ص َ ف ْ ي َ ك َ ل ِ ت ُ ق َّ م ُ ث ًۙ َ ر َّ م ُ ث ًۙ َ ر َ ظ َ ن َّ م ُ ث ًۙ َ ر َّ د َ ق َّ لْ ِ ا ا ٰٓ َ ذ ٰ ه ْ ن ِ ا ًۙ ُ ر َ ث ْ ؤ ُ ي ر ْ ح ِ س َّ لْ ِ ا ا ٰٓ َ ذ ٰ ه ْ ن ِ ا َ ل ا َ ق َ ف ًۙ َ ر َ ب ْ ك َ ت ْ س ا َ و َ ر َ ب ْ د َ ا َّ م ُ ث ًۙ َ ر َ س َ ب َ و َ س َ ب َ ع ة َ ح ا َّ و ـ َ ل ُ ر َ ذ َ ت َ لْ َ و ي ۪ ق ْ ب ُ ت َ لْ ۜ ُ ر َ ق َ س ا َ م َ ك ي ٰ ر ْ د َ ا ا ٰٓ َ م َ و َ ر َ ق َ س ِ ه ي ۪ ل ْ ص ُ ا َ س ۜ ِ ر َ ش َ ب ْ ل ا ُ ل ْ و َ ق ِ ر َ ش َ ب ْ ل ِ ل ۜ َ ر َ ش َ ع َ ة َ ع ْ س ِ ت ا َ ه ْ ي َ ل َ ع

8 A historical fact that supports the identification of the number 19 in sura AL - MUDDATHIR as the letters of BIS MILLAHIR RAHMANIR RAHIM ِ م ي ۪ ح َّ ر ل ا ِ ن ٰ م ْ ح َّ ر ل ا ِ ه اللّٰ ِ م ْ س ِ ب comes from reviewing the sequence of revelation of Qu r'an. As most of you know, the first time when the angel Gabriel. came to the Prophet Muhammad, he brought the first few verses of sura AL - ALAQ نزلت which is by the way sura number 19 from the end of Qur'an, and consists of 19 verses. In the second visit, the angel brought the first few verses of sura AL'QALAM, number 68. In the third visit, Gabriel brought to the Prophet the first few verses of sura AL - MUZZAMIL, number 73. In the fourth visit, Gabriel brought the first verses of sura AL - MUDDATHIR, up to ve rse 30 stating the number 19. Do you know what the angel brought immediately following this number 19? HE BROUGHT THE 19 LETTERS. BISMILLAHIR RAHMANIR RAHIM ( ِ ن ٰ م ْ ح َّ ر ل ا ِ ه اللّٰ ِ م ْ س ِ ب ِ م ي ۪ ح َّ ر ل ا ). In the fifth visit, the angel Gabriel brought the first CO MPLETE sura, and it was sura AL - FATHIHA, the opening sura, which begins with BISMILLAHIR RAHMANIR RAHIM. Therefore, it would seem reasonable to interpret the number 19 of sura ALMUDDATHIR as the letter of BISMILLAHIR RAHMANIR RAHIM as you will see througho ut this presentation, the 19 letters of BISMILLAHIR RAHIMANIR RAHIM do bear the indisputable proof that the Quran can never be man - made, and in this most profound way they offer the perfect answer to those who claim that the Qur'an is man - made. As you now know, the number 19 of sura ALMUDDATHIR is mentioned in connection with those who claim that the Qur'an is man - made. Although what we have seen so far provides ample proof that the Qur'an must be the word of God, that it can never be man - made, and that is God's unaltered message to all the people. Arabs and non - Arabs, as I mentioned before, this is only the tip of Iceberg . It seems that the almighty God wills that the evidence supporting His divine message shall be no less than

9 overwhelming. Thus, the gr eater portion of this physical, touchable, examinable and indisputable evidence is found in the mysterious letters which open certain suras. One of the Qur'an's unique properties is the existence of alphabetical letters at the beginning of some suras. Th ese letters, let us call them our "Qur ’ anic initials", are prefixed to 29 suras, and they bear no apparent meaning. For example, we find that sura number 1, AL - BAQARAH, starts with a verse that consists of 3 letters A.L.M. Alif Lam Mim . What do these lette rs mean? What is their significance? As you will see here and now, they bear indisputable evidence that the Qur'an is God's unaltered final message to all Humanity. These previously mysterious letters carry to us overwhelming proof that every letter in the Qur'an was placed according to a complex interlocking system that is far beyond human ability. We find exactly half the Arabic alphabets, 14 letters, participating in the make - up of exactly 14 different sets of Qur'anic initials and these initials prefi x 29 suras. The 14 letters are Alif, Ha, Ra, Sin, Sad, Ta, ' Ayn, Qaf, Lam, Mim, Nun, Ha and Ya . The 14 sets of initials are Qaf , Nun , Sad, Ta, Ha, Ya, Sin, Ta Sin, Ha mim:, Alif Lam Mim, Alif Lam Ra, Ta Sin Mim, Ayn Sin Qaf, Alif Lam Mim Sad and Kaf Ha Ya Ayn' Sad . The 29 suras that begin with Qur'anic initials are suras number 2, 3, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 19, 20, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 36, 38, 40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 50, & 68. These Qur'anic initials are unique having a consistent and direct relationship to the number 19 of the letters of BISMILLAHIR RAHMANIR RAHIM. To begin with as you see in physically indisputable numbers, 14 letters, participate in forming 14 sets of initials, and these are found in 29 suras. When you add up 14+14+29, you find the total 57, 19x 3.

10 Starting with a single - lettered Qur'anic initial, let us look at the initial Qaf . We find this letter as a Qur'anic initial, in 2 suras, sura QAF, number 50, and sura AL - SHURA, number 42. When you count the number of occurrence s of the letter Qaf , in sura QAF, you will find them 57, 19x 3. At this point, I urge you to count the letter Qaf yourself in sura QAF. This is a process that will take from you only 3 - 5 minutes, but it will afford you the chance to touch this great miracl e, and to find out for yourself. It is not the same as having me tell you how many Qafs are in sura QAF. If you do not know Arabic, all you need to do is to learn what the letter QAF looks like, then count the letter in sura QAF. This also demonstrates to you that the perpetual Qur'anic initial can be appreciated by any one not just the Arabs. Please take the few minutes to count the letter Qaf as it occurs in sura QAF, and you will find them 57. Now count the letter Qaf in the only other sura which contain s it as an initial, sura number 42, AL - SHURA, you will find that even though this sura is more than twice as long as sura QAF, it contains the same number of Qafs , 57. Not only will you note that the 2 suras have the same number of Qafs but when you add th e total number of Qafs in the 2 suras, 57+57, the result is 114, the same as the number of suras in the Qur'an, and 6 multiples of 19. Thus, if the letter Qaf stands for "Qur ’ an" and you will agree this is a reasonable assumption, then the 114 Qafs in the suras initial l ed with Qaf tells us loud and clear that the 114 suras of the Qur'an are the Qur'an, the whole Qur'an, and nothing but the Qur'an. WHO PLANNED AND DESIGNED THIS NUMERICAL BALANCE? WHO WOULD KNOW THE ONLY SURAS WHICH CONTAIN EQUAL NUMBERS OF THE LETTER QAF, 57 & 57. ADDING UP TO EXACTLY THE NUMBER OF SURAS IN THE QUR'AN? Who else but the author of the Qur'an, the Almighty God? We see h ere that God, knowing the distribution of individual alphabets within the Qur'an, even before it was completely revealed, placed the initial Qaf at the

11 beginning of the only 2 suras which contain 57 Qafs each, thereby making the total 57 and 57, equaling 1 14, and he kept these facts concealed for 14 centuries. It is our generation that was destined to uncover these physical facts, as part of the Qur'an's perpetuity, being Muhammad's perpetual miracle. The link between the Qur'anic initial Qaf and the number 19 is obvious. since 57= 19 x 3 and the total of Qafs , 114 equals 19x 6. We will see that 19, the number of letters in BISMILLAHIR RAHMANIR RAHIM, is the common denominator in ALL the Qur'anic initials. At this point, I wish to cite at least one exampl e to illustrate the great significance of the Quranic initials. Looking at sura QAF. verse 13, we find this a short verse which is usually recited by us without paying much attention. We pass by it casually; but it contains a most profound demonstration of how every letter in the Qur'an is divinely designed, calculated and carefully counted. This short verse says, 'Ad, Pharaoh, and the people of Lot ( وعاد وفرعون و اخوان لوط ). The people of Lot are mentioned in the Qur'an 12 times, and they are called consistently," Qawm Lut" except in sura QAF, where they are called " Ikhwan Lut ." They are consistently called Qawm Lut with only one exception, in sura QAF they are called " Ikhwan " instead of Qawm . As you see, had the word " Qawm " been used in sura QAF, what would happen to the number of letter Qaf in sura QAF? Of course, the count would increase by one, and we would find 58 Qafs in sura QAF instead of 57. 58, of course, is not multiples of 19, it is not divisible by 19, and when you add it to the 57 Qafs of the other Qaf initial l ed sura the total will come out 115, not 114. In other words, the whole numerical code will collapse, and the initial Qaf (Q) at the beginning of sura QAF and sura AL - SHURA would become meaningless. You see clearly that one word the a lteration of one word, destroys the numerical system, and makes it simply disappear. During the last 1400 years, if one word in sura QAF or sura AL - SHURA, one word that contains the letter Qaf, such

12 as Qad , Qala , Yaqulu , Qawm , etc., if any Qaf containing w ord was lost, introduced, or altered, the whole mathematical system we see here would have dis - appeared, and these miraculous features of the Qur'anic initials would have never been witnessed. Moving on the other Qur ’ anic initials, let us look at the let ter Nun . We find this letter in sura AL - QALAM, number 68. And when you count the occurrences of the letter Nun in this Nun - initialled sura, you find them 133, 19 x 7. As for the Qur'anic initial Sad , we find it at the beginning of 3 suras, sura 7 (Al - A'raf), sura 19 (Maryam), and sura 38 (Sad). Counting the occurrences of the letter Sad in these 3 suras, we find the total 152, 19 x 8. You will find details of the counts of all the Qur'anic initial s enclosed with this booklet. As you see, we are dealing with strict physical facts. No one can argue with you about the physical fact that the letter Qaf occurs in the 2 Qaf - initialled suras 114 times, 19 x 6; no one can argue with you about the physical fact that the letter Nun occurs in sura Al - Qalam, the only Nun - initialled sura, 133 times, 19x 7; and no one can argue about the physical fact that the 3 Sad - initialled suras contain 152 Sads, 19 x 8. Let me cite one more example to show the awesome contro l of individual alphabets in the composition of Qur'an. In sura number 7, Al - A'raf, which is initialled with the 4 letters A.L.M.S. ( Alif Lam Mim Sad) we note that verse 69 contains word BASTATAN and we note that the spelling of this word uses the letter S ad , instead of the letter Sin , as we write it in the Arabic language. You see, the whole Arabic language does not have the root word BASTATA بصطته with a Sad, which leaves no confusion that the word in verse 69 is BASTATA with a Sin . Furthermore, we are ta ught that this special way of spelling BASTATAN س بصطته is "TAWQIFIYYAH توقيفية , which means OBLIGATORY, and means that the angel Garbriel, when he brought this verse, he told

13 the Prophet. "Tell your revelation writers to write this word with a Sad , not a Sin ." Certainly, we can see very clearly the importance of having this word spelled with a Sad : for if it were written in the normal Arabic with a Sin , the total number of Sad in the 3 Sad - initialled sura (number 7, number 19 and number 38) would have beco me 151, which is not divisible by 19. In other words, the whole numerical system associated with the Qur'anic initials would have been upset, and God ’ s miraculous signs, the previously mysterious letters would have become meaningless. This illustrates agai n the intricate design of the alphabetical distribution within the Qur'an, and again proves in a most profound manner that the Qur'an was perfectly protected by the Almighty God from any distortion, alteration, addition, or loss. Thus, every generation of human beings will receive and witness Muhammad's perpetual miracle, the Qur'an, with the built - in numerical system which proves the 2 important facts (1) that the Qur'an is God's message to them all; and (2) that this final message from the Almighty comes to them perfectly preserved. Looking at the Qur'anic initials which consist of mo re than one letter, we find a most fascinating phenomenon. We find that not only these letters add up to multiples of 19 within the sura, but also when we add up the similar initials, individual initials, from all the suras with common initials, the total is found to the multiples of 19. In other words, if the addition is done horizontally within the sura, or vertically to involve all the suras with the same initial, either way, the total comes out multiples of 19. This explains to you what I meant when I s aid that this numerical system is "interlocking," and that the Almighty God had willed that the evidence supporting His message shall be no less than overwhelming. All the numbers of all the Qur ’ anic initials are enclosed in the accompanying printed mat erials, so I do not need to go through these details. But let us look at a couple of examples to illustrate

14 this interlocking system, and see how it is complete beyond human ability. When we look at Sura Ta Ha , number 20, which is initialled with the 2 let ters Ta and Ha , when you count the 2 letters Ta and Ha as they occur in this sura, you will find their total 342, 19x18. Now, the letter Ta occurs as a Qur'anic initial in 4 suras, number 20, 26 27 and 28. If you count the letter Ta in these 4 suras, and t hen count the letter Ha similarly in the 2 sura which arc initialled with it, namely, suras number 19 and 20, you will find that the grand total of' all Ta plus all Ha = 589, I9 x 31.
